thread:
kevin: Hey team. Heads up0confidentially0Im scheduled for shoulder surgery next Tuesday. Doctor recommends 4weeks of limited typing and no heavy mouse use. Can we arrange a temporary accommodation for reduced code review and more pair-programming? Not sure what forms I need.
nina (People Ops): Thanks for letting us know, @kevin. We can support this. Short checklist: 1) submit the Temporary Accommodation form so HR can document medical restrictions; 2) well coordinate with your manager on task redistribution and essential vs non-essential duties; 3) consider ergonomic peripherals/voice dictation tools. We handle these confidentially.
omar (Manager): Im sorry to hear that, Kevin. We can reassign long PR reviews and move you to a reviewer/observer role for 4 weeks. I can take your high-touch reviews and ask @sasha to handle the backlog. Also happy to set you up for pair sessions (shorter blocks).
kevin: Thanks, Omar. Pairing sounds great. For accessibility, Id prefer short 45min sessions and dictation-enabled notes. Also would like exemption from on-call pager for the recovery period if possible.
nina (People Ops): On-call exemption's doable as a temporary accommodation; manager approval required. Please send your expected restriction dates and any medical note if youre comfortable. We wont include medical details in the review file, just the accommodation summary and dates.
triage_bot: Reminder: submit "Temporary Accommodation" form: https://redwood.internal/forms/accom-temp. This creates a private case for HR/manager.
omar (Manager): Approved: temporary on-call exemption for 4 weeks. Ill update the rota and handle urgent pages or escalate to SRE if needed. Kevin, please DM me your recovery dates and ideal schedule.
kevin: I sent the DM with dates (surgery 2245010200, return-to-full-typing target 2245236000). Also sent a short MD note from the clinic. Appreciate the privacy.
nina (People Ops): Received. Ive opened a confidential accommodation entry (shoulder surgery: reduced typing, pairing, on-call exemption). End date set to 2245236000 with a 1-week check-in. We can extend if needed.
kevin: Will the accommodation be visible to my review committee? Concerned it might affect promotion timing.
nina (People Ops): Good question. Accommodation summaries are visible only to HR and your manager by default. We do not flag this as negative in performance processes. If you want, we can add a private annotation summarizing the temporary scope so reviewers understand context without medical details.
omar (Manager): Ill also note the temporary redistribution in my manager comments so reviewers know you were supported and expectations were adjusted. Your goals remain the same unless we explicitly change them.
kevin: Thank you all. Really appreciate the support and quick turnaround.
triage_bot: Action logged: accommodation-created by nina for kevin (type: medical-restriction, start: 2245010200, planned-end: 2245236000). Notifications: HR, manager.
kevin: Closing the loop. Ill ping if recovery timeline changes.
